metas.name: Avedon
metas.description: Richard Avedon's photographs didn't just reflect culture, they shaped it, and continue to do so. The feature documentary AVEDON traces the life and legacy of an artist who used fashion, portraiture, and commercial photography to explore identity, power, fear and beauty. With unprecedented access to Avedon's archive, including never before seen photos, behind the scenes recordings, and interviews with those who knew him best, AVEDON is a visually stunning examination of the mind of an artist who shaped our collective image of the 20th century. Available on Netflix in 4K.

metas.name: Instadocs: Jane Doe v. Cornell
metas.description: Instadocs goes inside the rape investigation and Jane Doe lawsuit at Cornell University, with the student journalists at the forefront of the story. Available on Netflix in 4K.

metas.name: Super Scam Me
metas.description: After years of reporting on the scam industry, Mariana van Zeller enters one of her most immersive investigations to date. In a real-life social experiment, she builds a new online dating persona and goes undercover as the target of a romance scam to understand and expose the tactics, technologies, and psychological manipulations these criminals utilize to deceive their victims. Available on Hulu in 4K.

metas.name: Instadocs: AI Gone Wild
metas.description: Did AI just commit a felony? "Instadocs" investigates the Hugging Face hack and why this cyberattack may be a warning shot for humanity's future. Available on Netflix in 4K.

metas.name: Clown Panic
metas.description: Revisits the bizarre nationwide hysteria of 2016, which began with reports of creepy clowns hiding near woods in South Carolina and quickly spiraled into widespread panic, school lockdowns, and police interventions across the United States. This in-depth documentary features interviews with eyewitnesses, law enforcement officials, cultural commentators, and professional clowns whose livelihoods were impacted by the craze. Available on Hulu in 1080p.

metas.name: The Last First: Winter K2
metas.description: K2's first winter ascent claimed 5 lives, revealing modern alpinism's struggles with commercialization, social media impact, and conflicts between marginalized climbers and traditional elites. Available on Apple TV in 4K.

metas.name: The Swan: Behind the Mirror
metas.description: A look at the controversial 2004 reality series The Swan, which took self-proclaimed 'ugly ducklings' and set out to make them... not that. Available on Hulu in 1080p.

metas.name: Tribeca 25
metas.description: Twenty-five years after 9/11, Tribeca 25 chronicles how Robert De Niro and Jane Rosenthal transformed an ambitious effort to revive Lower Manhattan into one of the world's leading cultural institutions. Through rare archival footage, exclusive interviews and behind-the-scenes access, the film explores how art can foster community, confront injustice, and help shape culture. Available on Netflix in 4K.

metas.name: Band of Brothers: Legacy
metas.description: This tribute to the groundbreaking series that helped preserve the story of Easy Company and deepened public appreciation for the sacrifices of the Greatest Generation features new interviews with cast members Damian Lewis, Ron Livingston, Michael Cudlitz, Capt. Dale Dye, USMC (Ret.), David Schwimmer, and more. Through personal reflections and behind-the-scenes stories, participants revisit the experience of making the series and explore its lasting cultural resonance, and also includes never-before-seen archival footage and photographs of Easy Company and World War II. Available on HBO Max in 4K.

metas.name: Instadocs: The Decoy Plane
metas.description: A critical threat. A clandestine escape. And a Turkish catering truck? With firsthand accounts, "Instadocs" digs into what happened aboard Air Force One. Available on Netflix in 4K.

metas.name: The Last Salute
metas.description: Chronicles the MiG-21's final chapter in the Indian Air Force, showcasing stories of generations of fighter pilots who flew it. Available on Netflix in 4K.

metas.name: Freefall: A Reckoning for Boeing
metas.description: Following the highly publicized death of Boeing whistleblower John Barnett, the investigation continues into the once-iconic aviation giant, uncovering startling new revelations and insider accounts in the wake of a deepening corporate crisis.. Available on Netflix in 4K.

metas.name: Big Chicken: A Fast Food Conspiracy
metas.description: In a bold 28-day experiment, comedian Mo Gilligan tours the UK and US on a fried chicken diet to uncover the impact of the craving — and industry behind it. Available on Netflix in 4K.

metas.name: Instadocs: The Prediction Games
metas.description: Prediction markets let anyone bet on anything, from the World Cup to alien invasions. "Instadocs" investigates the explosive rise of global betting. Available on Netflix in 4K.

metas.name: Heartstopper: Ending on a Hi
metas.description: After the ending of the hit Netflix series “Heartstopper”, this special combines never-before-seen behind-the-scenes footage, cast and crew interviews, larger cultural commentary, and fan input. Available on Netflix in 1080p.

metas.name: Euphoria: A Look Back
metas.description: The cast and crew of HBO's Euphoria take an exclusive look back at the critically acclaimed series' origins, evolution, and influences. Available on HBO Max in 1080p.

metas.name: A Toxic Love Story
metas.description: A string of threatening e-mails escalates into a revenge plot involving a newly-married US Marshal and his ex-girlfriend. Available on Netflix in 4K.

metas.name: My Grandfather Charles Manson
metas.description: Sophia was always the good girl growing up and her father's rock, but her quest to identify her unknown grandfather results in a shocking discovery: He is Charles Manson, history's most notorious criminal; and he bears striking physical similarities to her beloved father. Sophia's discovery propels her into an underworld of Manson family members and unreliable narrators as she traces her grandfather's life. Along the way, her genetics unlock never-before-released records and audio recordings that illuminate Manson's pathology in startling ways. But the more Sophia uncovers, the more her relationship with her father is strained. For Sophia, there's no turning back. What has she inherited, and how will she reckon with her family legacy? Available on Hulu in 4K.

metas.name: Unbreakable Me - The Gabrielle Daleman Story
metas.description: This inspiring documentary follows Gabrielle Daleman, two-time Canadian champion and 2018 Olympic gold medalist, as she battles injuries, illness, bullying, and mental health struggles. Beyond the medals and spotlight, she faces adversity with courage and grit, rising again and again to prove that her greatest strength isn't just on the ice - it's in her unbreakable spirit. Available on Prime Video in 1080p.

metas.name: The Welcome Table
metas.description: Tells the story of climate refugees across six continents, celebrating the voices and experiences of people living at the forefront of the climate crisis, displaced from their homes by climate disasters. Available on HBO Max in 4K.

metas.name: Spark Into a Flame
metas.description: Lin-Manuel Miranda and others set hip-hop and Broadway on fire in The Hamilton Mixtape. Available on Disney+ in 1080p.

metas.name: The Murder of Rachel Nickell
metas.description: In 1992, a young mother is killed in broad daylight on London’s Wimbledon Common, leaving her two-year-old toddler as the sole witness. Exploring the shocking real events behind the drama series The Witness, this gripping documentary from BAFTA-nominated director Lucy Bowden examines the notorious, years-long police investigation that followed. Featuring exclusive archive footage, first-hand accounts from family members, and insights from leading forensic experts, the film unpacks how a flawed, highly-publicised inquiry led to the wrong man's prosecution, before a stunning breakthrough reignited a family's fight for justice over a decade later. Available on Netflix in 4K.

metas.name: Instadocs: Alex Murdaugh, Unconvicted
metas.description: Why was Alex Murdaugh's conviction overturned? The debut of "Instadocs" digs into stunning allegations of jury interference in his double murder trial. Available on Netflix in 4K.

metas.name: The A List: 15 Stories from Asian and Pacific Diasporas
metas.description: Sandra Oh, Sen. Tammy Duckworth, Kumail Nanjiani, Amanda Nguyen, Connie Chung, and beyond: their worlds may be disparate, but they’ve all, in their unique ways, navigated what it means to be Asian in relation to their American identities. While their success has been fraught with racism, they share their stories of losses and wins. Available on HBO Max in 1080p.

metas.name: Marty, Life Is Short
metas.description: Martin Short looks back on a life fueled by joy in this documentary with classic clips, fresh interviews and star-studded, never-before-seen home movies. Available on Netflix in 4K.

metas.name: Perilous Passage: Birth in America
metas.description: A look at the impact of an already very precarious maternal health state in the U.S. post-rescinding of Roe v. Wade, via the Supreme Court's Dobbs decision, reversing rights that women have been working so hard to fight for, and that will actually have a deep impact that we can't even see just yet in terms of the numbers of mortality and trauma as a result of those very draconian policies. Available on HBO Max in 1080p.

metas.name: The Hollywood Rabbi
metas.description: How does the child of immigrants, raised on the Lower East Side of Manhattan, become Frank Sinatra’s personal rabbi, win two Academy Awards, mingle with four kings, three popes, eight presidents and a who’s who of Hollywood royalty while dedicating his life to healing the world through tolerance? Available on Netflix in 1080p.

metas.name: Marc by Sofia
metas.description: An intimate, unconventional portrait of Marc Jacobs, crafted by Sofia Coppola to capture the genius and singular universe of the iconic American designer. Available on HBO Max in 4K.

metas.name: The Plastic Detox
metas.description: Six couples with unexplained infertility reduce their plastic exposure to improve their chances of conceiving. Available on Netflix in 4K.

metas.name: #Skyking
metas.description: A troubled airport worker's impulsive decision to steal and fly a commercial plane becomes a gripping aerial drama that reflects deeper issues of mental health and working-class struggles in America. Available on Hulu in 1080p.

metas.name: Louis Theroux: Inside the Manosphere
metas.description: With rare access and no holds barred, the acclaimed documentarian investigates a growing ultra-masculine network and its controversial influencers. Available on Netflix in 4K.

metas.name: Contact in the Woods the Dr. Jonathan Reed Story
metas.description: One man's hike ends in a bloody alien encounter. After killing a visitor to save his dog, Dr. Jonathan Reed captured terrifying evidence before being hunted by dark forces. The mystery that remains the world's most polarizing UFO case. Available on Prime Video in 1080p.

metas.name: Ghost Elephants
metas.description: In Angola's mist-shrouded highlands, three KhoiSan master trackers embark on a spiritual quest to rediscover the legendary "ghost elephants" of Lisima, creatures presumed lost but remembered in ancestral trance, ritual, and memory. Available on Hulu in 1080p.

metas.name: Making of Lord of the Flies
metas.description: A trippy tale capturing the creative vision of writer Jack Thorne and director Marc Munden, as a British crew and young cast film this timely adaptation on the remote islands of Malaysia during monsoon season. The crew battle twisters, torrential rain and scary insects to create this hallucinatory fever dream, featuring behind-the-scenes interviews and mesmerising performances by the newbie cast. Available on Netflix in 1080p.

metas.name: Peaky Blinders: The Real Story
metas.description: A behind-the-scenes documentary uncovering the real history of Birmingham’s Peaky Blinders, separating fact from fiction in the hit TV series and exploring the creative vision behind its unique style. Available on Prime Video in 1080p.

metas.name: The Investigation of Lucy Letby
metas.description: An engaging and thought-provoking look at Lucy Letby, the former nurse serving life in prison after being convicted of the murders of seven infants and the attempted murders of seven others. Available on Netflix in 4K.

metas.name: DC Air Disaster: Final Minutes Revealed
metas.description: Discovery Channel's DC Air Disaster: Final Minutes Revealed (airing Jan. 29, 2026) investigates the Jan. 29, 2025, midair collision between a PSA Airlines jet and an Army Black Hawk over the Potomac, revealing fatal, un-alerted, last-second failures. The special highlights critical, previously undisclosed NTSB, cockpit audio, and ATC insights Available on HBO Max in 1080p.

metas.name: Mouth of the Wolf: Amanda Knox Returns to Italy
metas.description: Amanda Knox returns to Italy to confront Giuliano Mignini, the prosecutor who locked her up for a murder she did not commit. Available on Hulu in 1080p.

metas.name: One Last Adventure: The Making of Stranger Things 5
metas.description: An inside look at the years of effort and craft that went into the final installment of the Duffer Brothers' generation-defining series. Available on Netflix in 4K.
